title: Leota's Frozen Oddities

hints.text: Move farther into the grounds toward Madame Leota's garden and scan the small statuary.
Look for several little animals that seem caught in the middle of an enchantment.
Find the oddity statues—including frogs, lizards, rats, and a cymbal-playing monkey.

revealDescription: Madame Leota's garden contains a collection of strange little animal statues, including a cymbal-playing monkey, all posed as if frozen by a spell.
